name: iceinvein-skills
description: Thinking frameworks from foundational software engineering texts, installed as skills for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: bounded-context-auditor
plugins.description: Evans-inspired bounded context analysis: detect linguistic fractures, draw context maps, identify leaking language and shared model pollution

plugins.name: bug-hunter
plugins.description: Hunts logic and correctness bugs in a change or area and proves each one with a failing reproduction checked against stated intent. One agent collects intent from the request, specs, docs and unchanged code, runs QA-style scenarios from a catalog as repros in the repo's own test runner inside a scratch copy, and re-runs each failure clean before reporting it. Counts a contradicted claim, or a result wrong under every reading, as a bug; keeps ambiguities for questions with more than one acceptable answer; reports latent defects without filing them. No repro, no finding. Writes report.md and findings.json (bugs, ambiguities, covered) to .bug-hunter/<date>-<slug>/ and never modifies the caller's tree. Language-agnostic; ships no per-language scripts.

plugins.name: codebase-architecture
plugins.description: Architecture review for existing codebases or structured design for new projects, with patterns reference

plugins.name: cognitive-load-auditor
plugins.description: Jeff Johnson-inspired cognitive load analysis: evaluate UI against Miller's Law, Hick's Law, Fitts's Law, and working memory limits

plugins.name: cohesion-analyzer
plugins.description: Constantine & Yourdon-inspired cohesion analysis: classify module focus on the 7-level spectrum, find split lines, reduce mixed responsibilities

plugins.name: complexity-accountant
plugins.description: Ousterhout-inspired complexity analysis: deep vs shallow modules, complexity budget, justified abstractions

plugins.name: composability-auditor
plugins.description: Unix Philosophy-inspired composability analysis: identify reuse blockers, decompose self-sufficient units into composable pieces with standard interfaces

plugins.name: contract-enforcer
plugins.description: Meyer-inspired Design by Contract: preconditions, postconditions, invariants, and failure contracts for non-trivial functions

plugins.name: coupling-auditor
plugins.description: Constantine & Yourdon-inspired coupling analysis: classify, measure, and reduce interdependence between modules

plugins.name: cover-letter
plugins.description: Cover letter suite router. Dispatches to write, audit, rewrite, or persona subcommands and shares file I/O (PDF, DOCX, MD/MDX, URL), output formats, and writing conventions across the suite

plugins.name: cover-letter-audit
plugins.description: Scores a cover letter on 100 points across content/fit, structure, voice/humanness, and correctness; detects AI-generated-content signals and produces a prioritized fix list

plugins.name: cover-letter-persona
plugins.description: Reusable writing personas built on the NNGroup 4-dimension tone framework, adapted for professional correspondence and used by cover-letter-write and cover-letter-rewrite

plugins.name: cover-letter-rewrite
plugins.description: Audit-driven targeted rewrite of an existing cover letter. Focus modes: humanize, align, tighten, structure, tone; preserves voice where it already works

plugins.name: cover-letter-write
plugins.description: Generates a cover letter from a resume and job description. Outputs markdown, DOCX, and PDF; enforces human prose, maps every claim to a resume bullet, and covers top JD requirements without keyword stuffing

plugins.name: cqs-auditor
plugins.description: Meyer-inspired Command-Query Separation: classify functions as commands or queries, detect mixed violations, separate side effects from return values

plugins.name: demeter-enforcer
plugins.description: Lieberherr-inspired Law of Demeter analysis: detect chain violations, parameter drilling, and hidden traversal; fix with tell-don't-ask or parameter narrowing

plugins.name: dependency-direction-auditor
plugins.description: Martin-inspired dependency direction analysis: trace imports across layers, classify violations by severity, recommend inversion

plugins.name: design-review
plugins.description: Brooks-inspired design integrity review: tests conceptual integrity, constraint exploitation, removal discipline, and scope control

plugins.name: error-strategist
plugins.description: Duffy & Abrahams-inspired error handling: classify errors (bug/recoverable/fatal), assign safety guarantees, design recovery boundaries

plugins.name: event-design-reviewer
plugins.description: Evans/Vernon/Dahan-inspired event design: domain-meaningful naming, fat payloads, schema evolution, and the domain expert test

plugins.name: evolution-analyzer
plugins.description: Lehman-inspired software evolution analysis: trajectory assessment, debt visibility, and change impact on system health

plugins.name: gestalt-reviewer
plugins.description: Gestalt-inspired visual perception audit: proximity, similarity, closure, continuity, and figure-ground analysis for UI layouts

plugins.name: idempotency-guardian
plugins.description: Helland-inspired idempotency analysis: classify mutation points, check protection mechanisms, evaluate side effect safety for retry-safe systems

plugins.name: improve-my-codebase
plugins.description: Orchestrator skill that runs every applicable audit skill in parallel and produces a prioritized, convergence-ranked improvement report

plugins.name: integration-pattern-auditor
plugins.description: Hohpe & Woolf-inspired messaging analysis: name the integration pattern, verify delivery guarantees, identify missing infrastructure

plugins.name: magpie
plugins.description: Interactive PR review pipeline. Runs five parallel specialist subagents (security, bugs, performance, code-smells, architecture) plus a once-per-PR checks pass that finds tests and controls able to pass without proving their purpose, drops findings whose quoted evidence is not in the code, dedupes, runs critic subagents that re-check each finding against the worktree and set its risk label, peer-reviews via codex exec (falling back to a Claude second opinion when codex is unavailable), and serves an interactive HTML report for selecting or dismissing findings to post via gh, recording the outcome per finding as labels. Bundles a Bun CLI put on PATH by the skill's postinstall step under a bunx install, or by the plugin's bin/ under a Claude Code plugin install. Use when the user asks to review a GitHub pull request. Local mode (setup --local) runs the same pipeline on the current branch's diff from its merge base, uncommitted and untracked work included, against the caller's live tree, with no server or posting, and hands the ranked findings back in the terminal for an implementing or orchestrating agent to address. Splits oversized diffs into budgeted shards and rebuilds the diff from the local clone when gh pr diff refuses it.

plugins.name: migrate
plugins.description: Source-agnostic legacy migration mapping. Walks a legacy codebase through probe, enumerate, seam, extract, parity, queue, adjudicate and handoff, building an auditable requirements ledger with mandatory citations and a `migrate check` gate in place of self-reported completeness. Use when the user asks to migrate, re-specify, replatform, or map a legacy system onto a new stack, to hand mapped requirements to a delivery team, or to resume, check, report, or forecast a mapping run already under way.

plugins.name: module-secret-auditor
plugins.description: Parnas-inspired information hiding analysis: module boundaries drawn by change-reason, not by noun or technical layer

plugins.name: port-adapter-auditor
plugins.description: Cockburn-inspired hexagonal architecture analysis: identify ports and adapters, classify boundary health, ensure core testability and swappability

plugins.name: rams-design-audit
plugins.description: Dieter Rams-inspired design audit: every visual element must earn its presence, less but better, clarity through restraint

plugins.name: scope-estimate
plugins.description: Scopes and estimates a rebuild or respec of an existing system for a proposal: read-only discovery agents write cited inventories, a capability register gives every capability a status and a proposed disposition, area agents turn it into sized functional requirements, and a bundled Bun scheduler groups them into slices and contracts-first work packages and schedules them across engineers x worktrees at fast, planning and floor rates. The scheduler refuses a plan that misses or double-counts a requirement or has a dependency cycle, so every figure in the docs comes from one reproducible run. Also covers current and target architecture pages, proposal review, and a two-week calibration before committing to a date. Lighter than migrate: no store and no phase gates.

plugins.name: seam-finder
plugins.description: Feathers-inspired legacy code modification: find seams, make minimal incisions, preserve existing behavior

plugins.name: simplicity-razor
plugins.description: Hickey-inspired simplicity analysis: simple vs easy, complecting detection, strand decomposition

plugins.name: sluice
plugins.description: Routes work by change shape into four channels (bypass, fast, main, deep) and applies only the rules each channel needs, so a one-line fix does not pay the cost of a multi-subsystem build. Carries nine rules as one-liners in the router and the full treatment in references read only on friction. Checks the finished plan with plan.sh validate rather than trusting it to memory, seeds the run state from it, keeps a deep run's task breakdown in .sluice/run.json so a statusline segment, one status command and a SessionStart hook can answer where the run is (the hook prints a live run at every session start, compaction included), and closes each run with a ledger read out of the session transcript: elapsed, tools, tokens, and what each dispatched agent cost where the transcript recorded it. Two Stop hooks hold a handback: one refuses a tree that moved since its last recorded check, the other refuses a changed existing test not proven to fail on the session's starting code (or recorded with a reason). Claude Code only; stands down where the superpowers pipeline governs the repo.

hooks.command: echo 'Before acting on a request that changes code, pick a sluice channel and state which one.'; bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session-start.sh"

plugins.name: temporal-coupling-detector
plugins.description: Hidden ordering dependency analysis: detect two-phase init, method order dependencies, invisible preconditions, and resource lifecycle violations; fix with types, parameters, and factory patterns

plugins.name: terse
plugins.description: Professional output compression. Cuts ~20-30% of output tokens with proper grammar, a plain-language register, and semantic accuracy. Three levels: clean, tight, sharp.

plugins.name: type-driven-designer
plugins.description: Wlaschin & Minsky-inspired type design: make illegal states unrepresentable through branded types, discriminated unions, and domain-encoded constraints

plugins.name: unidirectional-flow-enforcer
plugins.description: Elm Architecture-inspired data flow analysis: enforce unidirectional state flow, detect bidirectional mutations, trace state lifecycle in UI applications
